The '''Trandoshan Four''' were a group of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] operating in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were the toughest and most dangerous group of bounty hunters in the region. At some point prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the Trandoshan Four were hired by [[Jock Tardee]] to kill [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] during their [[Mission to steal a DSS-02 shield generator|mission]] to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. However, they were all slain by Skywalker, and two [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] managed to escape.<ref name="Rebel Heist 2" />
